newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Canberra grants A$22 mln to textile industry.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Canberra grants A$22 mln to textile industry.

text.p: The Australian government said on Wednesday it would provide A$22 million over the next four years to help the textiles, clothing and footwear industry improve quality and training.
The funds were also aimed at helping the industry adopt best practice and achieve better supply chain management.
Technology Minister Peter McGauran said the industry would benefit from the government's economic and industry policies.
But he encouraged the industry to put its case to the upcoming productivity commission inquiry, which is considering whether assistance schemes should be continued beyond 2000.
"What happens with the textile, clothing and footwear industry as a result of this inquiry will be an important litmus test for future industry policy," McGauran said in a statement.
He said government policies would create the conditions for sustainable growth in the medium and long term as it offered scope for lower interest rates.
